metadata.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2 — CMMC L2 working catalog
metadata.remarks: Control titles/statements are paraphrased objective summaries for engineering traceability. The normative control text is NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2 (see back-matter). NIST publishes only Rev. 3 in OSCAL; CMMC L2 is assessed against Rev. 2, hence this local catalog.
